title: Clarify FHIR's role relative to the logical model and technology neutrality
requirements:
- State FHIR is recommended for relevant health-information exchange, with other standards where more suitable
- Clarify that FHIR readiness means FHIR-mappable semantics, not internal structures mirroring FHIR
- Present standards by purpose/artefact type, with governance and licensing noted
- Describe FHIR as a recommended standard within a broader portfolio, with stated versions and national profiles
- Explain how technology neutrality coexists with standards endorsement
- Present derivation from logical models as the preferred approach, not a property of all profiling
- State that the list is illustrative; include information-model formalisms (e.g. openEHR) and other relevant standards (UCUM, CDA, HL7 v2)
- Explain the complementary role of IHE profiles for end-to-end workflows
